rationale: No supported optimization is safe to apply. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (add Go module cache) is contraindicated because an equivalent cache already exists: the workflow uses actions/setup-go@v5 with cache: true, which caches ~/go/pkg/mod keyed by the lockfile, so adding a separate actions/cache would be redundant. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (add timeout-minutes) is not supported: ci_history has no measured durations (not_a_measured_baseline), so there is no representative successful-duration history to set a budget, and the job includes a race-regression step with -timeout=10m, meaning valid slow runs can exceed a short fixed limit (contraindication: valid slow runs exceed the proposed limit). Concurrency cancel-in-progress for pull_request is already present. Applying any of these would either duplicate existing behavior or risk cutting off valid runs without reducing required test coverage.
